trust_decision.summary: The user-stored blob ContentType decides the MIME type of a same-origin blob: URL opened in a new window. At the pinned commit the generated client's shared openFile helper passes it through unchanged, so a stored text/html or image/svg+xml blob runs script under the app origin. The fix allowlists raster image/* (not +xml) for image blobs and text/plain for text blobs, and forces application/octet-stream for everything else.

landing_point.why: The only place where a Blob is built with the stored contentType and opened through globalThis.open. A search for createObjectURL/openFile leads here first.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: React's openFile comes from the third-party react-jhipster dependency, not from code in this repo, so a solver who hardens the shared data-utils helper can argue React is the library's problem and leave it. They may also not notice that React passes (contentType, data) through a different implementation.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Raster image blobs (image/png, image/jpeg) must still open inline in a new window as images, and text/plain text blobs must still open as text. A fix that always forces a download, or always forces octet-stream, breaks the image-preview click on list and detail pages.

non-plain text types (text/html) on a text blob: download (fix.diff:222-225)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: downloadFile builds a Blob with the stored contentType. Removing tempLink.download, or a 'preview' variant that opens it with window.open, would be a second unguarded opener.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is already a second blob builder that copies the stored type verbatim; a maintainer adding a 'view' action next to 'download' would likely copy it.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Angular's DataUtils already wraps the shared helper. An inline reimplementation for a preview feature is a plausible copy-paste.
